65128-the-miserly-robot.creator: Unknown
65128-the-miserly-robot.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ses was found to state unequivocally: "It is my last testament, under the laws of Cornusia, that my longtime and good friend Nestor shall operate the finances of my estate for my son Harry, sole survivor, until...." And there followed, set down in tiny multitudinous lines of legal terminology peculiar to the age, the conditions and the length of the operation of the estate.

70599-the-trumpet-in-the-dust.title: In The Dust
70599-the-trumpet-in-the-dust.creator: Unknown
70599-the-trumpet-in-the-dust.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. es on the sunny square of her little window, she was conscious of actual enrichment, as if the sunshine itself were a tangible personal gift. To the pleasure of this was added the happy anticipation of something not yet quite within reach, thrilling her nerves as they had not been thrilled for years.

arxiv-2211-09327.title: Unique identification and domination of edges in a graph: The vertex-edge dominant edge metric dimension
arxiv-2211-09327.creator: Hafiz Muhammad Ikhlaq
arxiv-2211-09327.description: Abstract Dominating sets and resolving sets have important applications in control theory and computer science. In this paper, we introduce an edge-analog of the classical dominant metric dimension of graphs. By combining the concepts of a vertex-edge dominating set and an edge resolving set, we introduce the notion of a vertex-edge dominant edge resolving set of a graph.

arxiv-2302-03856.title: g g -mode of neutron stars in pseudo-Newtonian gravity
arxiv-2302-03856.creator: Hong-Bo Li, Yong Gao, Lijing Shao, Ren-Xin Xu
arxiv-2302-03856.description: Abstract The equation of state (EOS) of nuclear dense matter plays a crucial role in many astrophysical phenomena associated with neutron stars (NSs). Fluid oscillations are one of the most fundamental properties therein. NSs support a family of gravity g g -modes, which are related to buoyancy.

arxiv-2302-14728.title: Semantically Consistent Person Image Generation
arxiv-2302-14728.creator: Prasun Roy Saumik Bhattacharya Subhankar Ghosh Umapada Pal Michael Blumenstein
arxiv-2302-14728.description: Abstract We propose a data-driven approach for context-aware person image generation. Specifically, we attempt to generate a person image such that the synthesized instance can blend into a complex scene. In our method, the position, scale, and appearance of the generated person are semantically conditioned on the existing persons in the scene.

arxiv-2307-15160.title: A study of the measurement of the τ \tau lepton anomalous magnetic moment in high energy lead-lead collisions at LHC
arxiv-2307-15160.creator: Monica Verducci, Natascia Vignaroli, Chiara Roda, Vincenzo Cavasinni
arxiv-2307-15160.description: Abstract The τ \tau lepton anomalous magnetic moment: a τ = g τ − 2 2 a_{\tau}=\frac{g_{\tau}-2}{2} was measured, so far, with a precision of only several percents despite its highly sensitivity to physics beyond the Standard Model such as compositeness or Supersymmetry.

arxiv-2311-06895.title: Asymmetric Design of Control Barrier Function for Multiagent Autonomous Robotic Systems
arxiv-2311-06895.creator: Hiroki Etchu, Yuki Origane, Daisuke Kurabayashi
arxiv-2311-06895.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a method to avoid “no-solution” situations of the control barrier function (CBF) for distributed collision avoidance in a multiagent autonomous robotic system (MARS). MARS, which is composed of distributed autonomous mobile robots, is expected to effectively perform cooperative tasks such as searching in a certain area.

arxiv-2506-13459.title: Breakthrough Listen: A Technosignature Search Around 27 Eclipsing Exoplanets Selected from the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite Catalogue
arxiv-2506-13459.creator: R. Barrett, C.D. Tremblay, B. Addison, D.C. Price, J. A. Green
arxiv-2506-13459.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by R. Barrett, C.D. Tremblay, B. Addison, D.C. Price, J. A. Green. Here we analyse the archival data for a set of 27 Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite ( TESS ) Targets of Interest (TOIs) in search for artificially generated radio signals, or ‘technosignatures’, interrupted by occultation. Exoplanetary eclipses are notable events to observe in the search for technosignatures, as they mark the geometrical alignment of the target, its host star, and Earth.

arxiv-2510-00414.creator: Matthew Yue, Zhikun Xu, Vivek Gupta, Thao Ha, Liesel Sharabi, Ben Zhou
arxiv-2510-00414.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Matthew Yue, Zhikun Xu, Vivek Gupta, Thao Ha, Liesel Sharabi, Ben Zhou. Most dating technologies optimize for getting together, not staying together. We present RELATE-Sim, a theory-grounded simulator that models how couples behave at consequential turning points—exclusivity talks, conflict-and-repair episodes, relocations—rather than static traits.

arxiv-2510-18499.creator: Hyewon Lee, Junghyun Oh, Minkyung Song, Soyoung Park, Seunghoon Han
arxiv-2510-18499.description: Abstract . This study presents the multilingual e-commerce search system developed by the DILAB team, which achieved 5th place on the final leaderboard with a competitive overall score of 0.8819, demonstrating stable and high-performing results across evaluation metrics. To address challenges in multilingual query–item understanding, we designed a multi-stage pipeline integrating data refinement, lightweight preprocessing, and adaptive modeling.

arxiv-2601-21177.title: Flow Perturbation++: Multi-Step Unbiased Jacobian Estimation for High-Dimensional Boltzmann Sampling
arxiv-2601-21177.creator: Xin Peng, Ang Gao
arxiv-2601-21177.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xin Peng, Ang Gao. The scalability of continuous normalizing flows (CNFs) for unbiased Boltzmann sampling remains limited in high-dimensional systems due to the cost of Jacobian-determinant evaluation, which requires D D backpropagation passes through the flow layers. Existing stochastic Jacobian estimators such as the Hutchinson trace estimator reduce computation but introduce bias, while the recently proposed Flow Perturbation method is unbiased yet suffers from high variance.

pmc-10328271.creator: Matthew E. Gegg
pmc-10328271.description: the endolysosomal system are now being recognized. The identification of VPS13C and LRRK2 at MCS, protein products of the familial Parkinson’s disease (PD) loci PARK23 and PARK8, respectively, and the well-established dysfunction of the endolysosomal system and mitochondria in disease pathogenesis, arguably put PD at the forefront of MCS involvement in neurological disease.

pmc-10663822.title: A new technique inversion Time-Domain electromagnetic data
pmc-10663822.creator: Widodo
pmc-10663822.description: Time-Domain Electromagnetic (TDEM) data modeling, especially for central-loop configurations, is often achieved through 1D inversion models. This study aims to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of TDEM data inversion by employing the Born Approximation method to address calculation and convergence speed issues.

pmc-11334154.title: In situ growth of CaMoO4 on electropolymerized PANI as a hybrid electrocatalyst for enhanced oxygen evolution†
pmc-11334154.creator: Nitika Garg, Ashok K. Ganguli
pmc-11334154.description: Electrochemical water splitting stands as a promising avenue for sustainable hydrogen production, with the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) playing a pivotal role. Efficient and durable electrocatalysts are crucial for expediting the sluggish kinetics of OER. In this work, we investigate the synthesis and performance of a novel CaMoO4/polyaniline (CaMoO4/PANI) composite catalyst for OER.

pmc-11393423.title: Tumor suppressor BAP1 suppresses disulfidptosis through the regulation of SLC7A11 and NADPH levels
pmc-11393423.creator: Jin Wang, Minglin Wang, Shaobo Wu, Yanan Zhu, Kexin Fan, Yuhan Chen, Zhengtao Xiao, Jing Chen, Kangsheng Tu, Dongsheng Huang, Yilei Zhang, Qiuran Xu
pmc-11393423.description: BAP1, BRCA1-Associated Protein 1, serves as a novel tumor suppressor through the deubiquitination of monoubiquitination of H2A and subsequent gene transcriptional regulation. Regulated cell death like apoptosis or ferroptosis is considered an essential mechanism mediating tumor suppression. Previous reports, including ours, have demonstrated that BAP1 could promote apoptosis and ferroptosis to inhibit tumor development.

pmc-11478645.title: The Impact of 24 h Urinary Potassium Excretion on High-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol and Chronic Disease Risk in Chinese Adults: A Health Promotion Study
pmc-11478645.creator: Xiaofu Du, Xiangyu Chen, Jie Zhang, Feng Lu, Chunxiao Xu, Jieming Zhong
pmc-11478645.description: Background: Research into the pivotal role of potassium in chronic diseases and their comorbidities remains scarce. Our aim is to elucidate the relationship between potassium and chronic diseases, including comorbid conditions, and to provide evidence-based recommendations for potassium intake in patients.

pmc-11480440.title: Site differentiation strategy for selective strontium uptake and elution within an all-inorganic polyoxoniobate framework
pmc-11480440.creator: Yi-Xin Liu, Ping-Xin Wu, Jing-Yi Dai, Ping-Wei Cai, Cai Sun, Shou-Tian Zheng
pmc-11480440.description: Selective uptake and elution of trace amounts of hazardous radioactive 90Sr from large-scale high-level liquid waste (HLW) is crucial for sustainable development. Here, we propose a site differentiation strategy, based on the presence of distinct selective metal capture sites (concavity site and tweezer site) within the giant polyoxoniobate (PONb) nanoclusters of an all-inorganic PONb framework (FZU-1).

pmc-11512772.title: Application Value of Platelet-to-Lymphocyte Ratio as a Novel Indicator in Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Review Based on Clinical Evidence
pmc-11512772.creator: Shengfeng Liu, Jian Liu, Xueni Cheng, Dahai Fang, Xiaolu Chen, Xiang Ding, Xianheng Zhang, Yiming Chen
pmc-11512772.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronically progressive autoimmune disease with increasing age-standardized prevalence and incidence of RA worldwide. Its pathological features are persistent synovitis of the joint, accompanied by the release of a large number of inflammatory cytokines and cartilage and bone destruction.

pmc-13088437.title: Percutaneous thermal ablation-based locoregional treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma larger than 3 cm: a 10-year single-center retrospective study
pmc-13088437.creator: Wen Luo, Li-Na Pang, Lu Han, Xiao-Bin Li, Xiao-Yu Li, Hai-Jing Liu, Xiao Yang, Lei Ding, Pei-Di Zhang, Jin Liu, Guang-Bin He, Xiao-Dong Zhou, Ming Yu
pmc-13088437.description: ObjectivesTo investigate the long-term efficacy of percutaneous thermal ablation (PTA)-based locoregional treatment of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) bearing tumors > 3 cm.MethodsIn this single-center, retrospective study of 359 HCC patients with 587 tumors (5.1 ± 0.021 cm) treated with PTA-based locoregional treatment between 2011 and 2021 was performed.
